name: Veridis Environment
summary: Veridis Environment Ltd, an Israeli firm established in Herzliya in 1993, delivers comprehensive environmental services across waste management, water solutions, and energy generation. Its waste management offerings span the entire cycle, from collection and transportation to separation, sorting, recycling, and final disposal. Furthermore, it transforms waste into valuable recycled materials and renewable energy sources. In the water sector, Veridis operates a desalination plant, ensuring the provision of fresh water to residential users, industrial operations, and agricultural clients. Beyond this, the company actively develops and manages power stations and facilities leveraging a variety of renewable energies, including biomass, cogeneration, and biogas. Its energy expertise also includes designing and operating energy centers and efficiency initiatives, along with offering installation and ongoing maintenance for heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems. Veridis Environment Ltd is a subsidiary of Delek Automotive Systems Ltd.
